title: TenancyPlanChangedPayload
description: Payload of `tenancy.plan.changed` version 1: a partner's plan changed, by platform staff, at a moment they scheduled, or when the Pro trial ended; every service of a kind the new plan lacks was disabled in the same act and announces it with `tenancy.service.updated`. The envelope's `partner_id` is the partner. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

partner_id.description: The partner, the same value as the envelope's `partner_id`.

trial_ended.description: `true` when the Pro trial ended with this change.
